decision: Every step leads with one plain sentence; engineering detail is one key away (E)
why: The audience is a non-technical founder. If they understand it, an engineer will too, and the engineer can still press E.
alternative: Engineering labels on the diagram with a glossary.
value: Nobody stops at a word they don't know; nobody loses depth.

decision: Start from a plain results file per system per minute, keyed by source and minute
why: Files are cheap to produce, easy to replay and safe to receive twice when the key is the source and the minute.
alternative: A streaming connector per source system.
value: Late or duplicate files are harmless, and any day can be rebuilt from the files.

decision: Validate schema and ranges before storing; quarantine bad files with a reason
why: A wrong number that reaches a report costs trust that takes months to earn back.
alternative: Store everything and clean it up in the report query.
value: What people see is always checked, and every rejection explains itself.

decision: Compare with a seasonal baseline per metric, store and hour of the week, not a fixed threshold
why: Monday at 14:00 in one store looks nothing like Saturday at 11:00 in another; a single threshold either spams or sleeps.
value: Alerts fire on what is unusual for this store, now, and anyone can read why.

decision: Numbers come from the data; the AI writes only the sentence and a checker verifies every number before sending
why: Language models are good at sentences and unreliable with arithmetic; the checker makes a wrong number impossible to send.
alternative: Let the model read the raw table and write the report.
value: Zero numbers written by the AI itself, by construction.

decision: The report proposes a likely cause and a fix; a person approves it, shown as Simulated AI with its sources
why: Switching payment providers is a business decision. The AI saves the digging, not the judgment.
value: Fast decisions with a clear owner and an audit trail.
